    target_clauses.append([b, c, d])
    
    # False constant F
    F = new_var()

    # map literal to target var: +x -> xT, -x -> xF

        xF[x] = new_var()
        target_clauses.append([xT[x], xF[x], F])
    
    def lit_var(lit):
        # lit is +v or -v

        else:
